## About Lisa

Lisa Nguyen is Chief Customer Officer of RetailFlow, a role created 2 years ago when Emma recognized that customer experience needed executive-level ownership. She joined from a telecommunications company where she led customer experience.

Lisa is a strong advocate for AI-powered customer service, seeing it as the fastest path to improving satisfaction metrics.

## Customer Focus

- Customer satisfaction improvement
- Response time reduction
- AI chatbot implementation
- Customer experience metrics
